name: gulf-national-id-input
title: Gulf national ID input
description: A national ID for the UAE, Saudi Arabia (ID or Iqama), Kuwait, Qatar or Bahrain, grouped as it is typed. UAE, Saudi and Kuwait numbers are checked against their check digit; Qatar and Bahrain get a shape check.
docs: Needs a shadcn project (Tailwind and the shadcn CSS variables). Works with and without `shadcn init --rtl`: set dir="rtl" on <html> or a parent for Arabic. Pass every label, help text and error message as props.
